description: This file defines a custom exception class 'UnknownCommandResponseException' used within the org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter package. It extends the DittoRuntimeException and represents situations where a command response is not supported by the protocol adapter. The class includes builder methods, static factory methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and defines related constants and nested builder class.

classes.name: UnknownCommandResponseException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when an unsupported command response is encountered. Extends DittoRuntimeException and provides builder methods for creating exception instances.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing an UnknownCommandResponseException with a specific response name.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an UnknownCommandResponseException instance from a message string and command headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an UnknownCommandResponseException instance from a JSON object and command headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified headers, preserving other details.
